groups.contract: Recipe replacement preserves construction family and typed anatomical placement dispatch
groups.disposition: Both complete bodies read. ParametricDesign validates through its actual owning variant; same_family uses inner helmet/limb discriminants or semantic kind, with distinct waist/trunk/underlayer roles. Embedded catalogue uses decode then retains typed recipes; unknown item yieldsNone and dedicated vambrace/breastplate bypass is explicit, not a fabricated fallback. FitRegion dispatch requests lateral side only for actual paired classes and errors for Unpaired. Forearm validate checks counts for normals/skin/UV face rows, rig columns and all morph positions/normals/rig lengths, then requires actual skin family. It does not itself prove face index membership or finite weights/native geometry; actual downstream source contract remains necessary. Full catalogue/family/schema fixture bodies read, not executed. Existing baseline03/06 findings remain adopted; no new baseline type-ownership audit is claimed.

groups.contract: Armory retained fits and display indices follow actual exhibit construction, with explicit error presentation
groups.disposition: All three complete bodies personally read. UI list/labels choose actual enumerate indices; step controls skip zero count before rem_euclid and onlystep -2..2, so ordinary finite catalogue avoids isize capacity issues. Refit retains selected only if <newlen, stale indices derive0..len and fit vectors collect one result per placement. Fit worker chunks use available_parallelism nonzero or4 and max1; joined handles preserve source chunk order. Bounds/arrange uses fixed nonempty row groups, no empty width subtraction bug, and ordinary failed fits use deliberate.2 placeholder. Exhibit item/bounds/failure[0] requires at least one nonempty retained surface placement; exact catalogue wearable producer obligation remains open until its original frontier, so comment alone is not proof for arbitrary raw catalogue. Rendering iterates same fitted/placements vector; per-piece material/construction failure is represented in status, but spawn may have emitted earlier placement entities before later Err. No all-or-nothing preview publication contract or normal bad scene established; preserve this explicit UI failure boundary. Refit_all flag is consumed before BareBody generation; failure reports status and keeps old body, and explicit Refit all button permits retry, not a proven retry-clock defect. No renderer/GPU execution.

groups.contract: Body cache key and camera framing separate retained identity from outfit presentation
groups.disposition: All bodies read. BareBody key clears outfit and name before equality, retains model LOD/correctives and rest of recipe; generated result is captured with that key only on success. Armory camera saves actual orbit on entry and checked Some is taken on exit; changed defaults mark studio dirty. Targets reduce actual finite fit positions and defer framing until actual bounds; midpoint/norm require supported generated coordinates, not guaranteed by raw floats or a UI comment. Label projection errors skip before egui positions. Off-tab display hides old wall/light/body and shows character per tab policy before any arbitrary exhibit lookup. Full visibility regression fixture read only. Shape fidelity/posed clearance remain independent acceptance and are not inferred from successful fitting, triangle count or documentation.
